description: This file defines a class `EmptyNode` which extends `Node` within the Twig templating engine, representing an empty node in a syntax tree.

classes.name: EmptyNode
classes.description: A final class representing an empty node in Twig's syntax tree, with no children allowed.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmptyNode with an optional line number.

methods.name: setNode
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to prevent adding children to this node, throws a LogicException if called.
